scripts.label: 🚀 Start Control Panel
scripts.description: Double-click the bat file in the repo folder. Opens PowerShell running the Node server, waits 3 seconds, then opens the browser automatically.

scripts.label: Sync Skills
scripts.description: Copies skill .md files from mmg-tools into ~/.claude/skills so they are available in all Claude sessions. Run after editing any skill file.

scripts.label: Start Server (manual)
scripts.description: Run from a PowerShell window inside the project folder. Tokens are loaded from .env automatically — no extra flags needed.

scripts.label: Claude Config Backup
scripts.description: Backs up Claude skills, agents, memory files and CLAUDE.md files to git. Now runs automatically every Monday at 9am — only run manually if you need it immediately.

scripts.label: Deploy to Vercel (git push)
scripts.description: Stages all changes, commits, and pushes to main. Vercel picks up the push and starts a production deployment. Check the Deploy tab to monitor progress.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "your message" && git push

scripts.label: Pre-Deploy Check
scripts.description: Runs all pre-deployment checks — type-checks, linting, build validation. Run before pushing to Vercel to catch errors locally first.

scripts.label: Locale Parity Check
scripts.description: Checks every page exists in both en and zh locale files. Flags pages missing a translation so nothing goes live without a Chinese version.

scripts.label: Sync Pricing from Excel
scripts.description: Reads the master pricing spreadsheet and writes updated data into the Next.js content files. Run whenever prices change.

scripts.label: Kill port 3010 (Control Panel)
scripts.description: Kills the process on port 3010. Useful if a stale Control Panel server is running and the bat file can't start a new one.

scripts.label: Kill port 3000 (Next.js dev)
scripts.description: Kills the process on port 3000 — usually the Next.js dev server. Find the PID with netstat first, then kill it.
